title: Rental Book Credit on LandlordGuard Renewals — Umbrella-Scheduled Units
content:
**Rule.** The rental book credit on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal paid in full looks at the rental units the named insured schedules on a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy in force, and its form depends on the size of that book:

- a book of four or more units is credited 25.00 USD for each scheduled unit as the flat account credit, taken off the premium after the account adjustment percentage;
- a book of two or three units is credited 2 percent inside the account adjustment percentage, taken off that percentage, which is applied once to the smaller of the indicated renewal premium and the capped expiring premium;
- a book of fewer than two units, or no umbrella in force, is credited nothing.

The rental units are the count carried on the named insured's Larkspur umbrella in force.

| Rental units scheduled on the umbrella in force | Form of the credit | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | flat account credit after the percentage | 25.00 USD per unit |
| 2 or 3 | inside the account adjustment percentage | 2 percent |
| 0 or 1, or no umbrella in force | none | nothing |

## Hypothetical books

| Units on the umbrella | Credit |
|---|---|
| 6 | flat 150.00 USD (6 units at 25.00 USD) |
| 4 | flat 100.00 USD |
| 3 | 2 percent |
| 1 | nothing |

For a six-unit book, a hypothetical premium of 1,960.00 USD after the account adjustment percentage is reduced by 150.00 USD to 1,810.00 USD. For a three-unit book, the 2 percent is taken off the account adjustment percentage before it is applied; it is not taken off the premium afterwards.
